root_idea.summary: The root centers on being specially favoured with pleasant provision and ease, yielding the notions of abundance, comfort, luxury, and indulgence.
root_idea.development: The lexical development runs from pleasant nourishment and a life of ease to the person so indulged, and then to the insolence or wrongdoing that may result from such abundance. Separate lexical branches include a novel pleasing gift and terms for an upper-lip protuberance.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form IV perfect citation form.
Displayed under the singular passive-participle citation form.

senses.definition: To grant someone a life of ease, abundance, and luxury; to be given such a life.
senses.usage_conditions: A causative Form IV use. The Quranic occurrences include both active forms describing the bestowal of luxury and passive forms describing those who have been given it.

senses.definition: A person granted abundant ease, comfort, and luxury; an affluent or indulged person.
senses.usage_conditions: A passive participle commonly substantivized and inflected in the plural in Quranic usage, referring to people enjoying received abundance or an affluent way of life.

senses.definition: A privileged chief or leader of a community, especially a leader associated with wrongdoing.
senses.usage_conditions: A reported interpretation of the Quranic construction أَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا; this reading foregrounds the influential or corrupt leadership of the affluent class rather than merely its prosperity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enjoy or lead a plentiful, pleasant, easy, soft, or delicate life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I use describing a person's manner of life.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a plant or herbage: to become luxuriant, flourishing, succulent, or fresh through abundant irrigation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of vegetation and its fresh, thriving condition.
A verbal-noun use associated with being well fed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To render a person submissive or compliant.
To make a person a king or prince.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form II construction expressing elevation to rulership.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone, through wealth or abundant ease, to become insolent, rebellious, extravagant in wrongdoing, and ungrateful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction in which wealth, divine provision, or plentiful living produces excessive pride or disobedience.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone the object of his eager desire, longing, or appetency.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive causative construction with the desired object as its complement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To persist in, resolve upon, or deviate into transgression, wrongdoing, or the abandonment of the right way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive or non-object-focused use describing settled persistence in wrongdoing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To magnify oneself and behave proudly, haughtily, or insolently; to become exorbitant in disobedience or wrongdoing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X reflexive or intransitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Plentifulness, pleasantness, ease, softness, or delicacy of life; comfort and affluence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting an affluent and comfortable way of living or the abundance underlying it.
A noun used for agreeable or choice nourishment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A new, rare, strange, or pleasing gift specially assigned for a friend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The item is characterized as novel or specially selected and as giving distinction or pleasure to its recipient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A naturally protuberant part in the middle of the upper lip.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun use for a drinking implement or container.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a natural protuberance in the middle of the upper lip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective describing the anatomical feature associated with تُرْفَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One left free to do as he wishes and not prevented from doing so.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participle use emphasizing lack of restraint or hindrance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One whom wealth or ease makes exultant, insolent, and ungrateful; a proud or tyrannical person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A characterization of the person affected by abundant prosperity, distinct from the neutral description of affluence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One made soft or delicate in body and rendered submissive.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited lexical application specifies a boy, but the evidence does not establish an exclusive object-class restriction.

cautions: The Form IV public headword is normalized to the active perfect أَتْرَفَ even though the Quranic group contains both active and passive inflections.
The Quranic nominal group is displayed under singular مُتْرَفٌ although all five Quranic occurrences are inflected passive participles functioning substantivally.
The corrupt-leaders interpretation of مُتْرَفِيهَا is a reported contextual reading of its Quranic construction; the core lexical sense remains people granted or enjoying abundance.
The upper-lip meaning is directly recorded in the supplied lexical evidence, while the Maqayis entry disputes that attribution and treats the form as a mistake for another word.
